sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Short relationship questions that build party history with consent.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use before play to create one or two playable relationships between PCs.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use before play to create one or two playable relationships between PCs.
One player offers a memory or relationship prompt; the other player answers from their character's point of view.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.
